description: Remove the open password from an encrypted Word .docx (Agile encryption, Office 2010+) using the known password, with integrity (HMAC) verification. Returns the decrypted .docx as base64. A wrong password returns a clear WRONG_PASSWORD error; this tool does not crack or guess passwords. Max input 20MB base64. Privacy: when called remotely (Streamable HTTP / SSE) the file is uploaded to the DocMorph server and processed in memory only; it is not written to disk or retained after processing, and passwords and file contents are never logged. When the MCP server runs locally over stdio, the file is processed entirely on this machine.

base64Docx.description: Base64 encoded encrypted .docx binary data (or data URI)

fileName.description: Optional original filename (e.g. report.docx); used to name the output file

name: word_remove_password
